limitations: All robotics adapters and PHC-to-radio transfers are proposed, unimplemented and unqualified by this manuscript.
No gPTP interoperability, IEEE 802.1AS or IEC/IEEE 60802 conformance, wireless TSN data plane, robot-output or functional-safety qualification is asserted.
Mode A follows the wired domain; Mode B Ethernet egress is later research; Mode C transparent/network-segment gPTP over BLE is outside the initial implementation.
TAI representation and time-property propagation are future explicit firmware work, not a relabelling of current root-relative/POSIX-style coordinates.
Historical PToB residuals remain conditional source-relative populations, with missingness and failures retained; no absolute UTC, RF-endpoint or independent sensor/output accuracy inferred.
Motion, holdover, wire occupancy, simplified gate-window, Bernoulli and candidate pilot examples are analytical proposals, not measurements or universal robotics requirements.
Standards survey inspects official status/scope and implementation documentation, not full normative standards, amendments or conformance clauses.
Public derivatives reproduce selected analysis; private raw extraction and operational hardware records were not imported or rerun.
local_commit_policy: Keep matching source, PDF, verifier, edition manifest and changelog together. Local preparation only; no push, release, submission or draft promotion authorized.
